data.generalSituation: The northeast monsoon will moderate gradually in the next couple of days. The weather will be mainly fine and become very hot over the coast of Guangdong. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Surigae will move across the western North Pacific to the east of the Philippines and intensify gradually today. It will move towards the vicinity of the Luzon Strait and the seas east of Taiwan in the next couple of days. It will then have a higher chance of turning northwards towards Japan. There will also be chance that it will move across Taiwan and towards the coast of eastern Guangdong. Winds are expected to be weak over Guangdong and under the influence of subsiding air, the weather will be generally fine over the region early to midweek next week. It will be extremely hot over inland areas. Another surge of the northeast monsoon is expected to affect southern China in the latter part of next week. There will be a few showers over the region and high temperature weather will be alleviated.
